newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche shares reach new record high.
newsitem.headline: Porsche shares reach new record high.

text.p: Shares in German carmaker Porsche AG on Tuesday reached a new record high at 1,840 marks ($1,100) in bourse dealings, helped by a buy rating from Lehmann Brothers, according to traders.
Porsche shares were up 75 marks at 1,840 marks in limited volumes.
Lehmann said it raised its share outlook for Porsche to 3,000 marks for mid-1998 from 2,000 marks and raised its rating to buy, noting the 2,000 mark level should be reached in mid-1997.
The brokerage house said Porsche's 1995/96 business year results released in January were better than expected.
